** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Include the destination in accessible card and action names.** The poster button’s `aria-label` hides its destination tag. The drag button’s `aria-label` also hides its visible destination-specific text. When two copies have the same title but different destinations, screen-reader users cannot identify the destination from these controls. Include the translated destination in the card or poster name and in the drag action name. Also applies to: 89-89

**Mark the copy seen when a file action is invoked.** The ready card keeps the copy unseen after “Show in Finder” or a file drag. Use the same invocation-time transition as the existing export-ready card.
Suggested fix
```diff +import { markCopySeen } from "@renderer/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies"; import type { ReadyCopy } from "@renderer/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies"; ... - onClick={() => void window.electronAPI.revealLocalRecording(localId)} + onClick={() => { + markCopySeen(video.assetId); + void window.electronAPI.revealLocalRecording(localId); + }} ... // Main runs a native drag (a real file), so the browser's own drag never starts. e.preventDefault(); + markCopySeen(video.assetId); window.electronAPI.startFileDrag(localId, video.title); ```
